Some of the most notable moons are the four largest, known as the Galilean moons, which were discovered by Galileo Galilei in 1610. These are Io, Europa, Ganymede, and Callisto. Besides these, there are numerous smaller moons with irregular orbits, many of which were discovered through space missions such as the Galileo spacecraft, the Voyager missions, and more recent observations from the Hubble Space Telescope and ground-based telescopes. The list of all moons is continually updated as new moons are discovered and confirmed.
